first_words: he passed out on the train tracks
with his head right on the rail
Seconds later, a cargo train came roaring toward him
It hit him in the head
and dragged him under the train
When it screeched to a stop
everyone was sure he was dead
Being that drunk had left his whole body completely loose
So, instead of fighting the impact, he moved with it
He walked away with just a few cuts on his hand
